title: Toolchain refresh: Kotlin 2.x, Compose compiler plugin, Compose BOM, Material3 1.3, lifecycle, version catalog
lead: Owner decision (2026-10-03): refresh the toolchain before the UI slices, so every later slice builds on current APIs.
findings_note: app/build.gradle:1-5,35-61 (Kotlin 1.9.20, Compose 1.5.4, Material3 1.2.1, lifecycle 2.6.2 vs 2.8.2, versions inline); gradle/libs.versions.toml
boundary: **Not in this slice:** raising `targetSdk` (S48), removing unused dependencies (S46), adding any library that is not listed below, and any behaviour change.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- The build uses Kotlin 1.9.20 with Compose compiler 1.5.4, Compose 1.5.4 and Material3 1.2.1. These are 2023 releases. Later slices need newer APIs: `Icons.AutoMirrored` for RTL, `androidx.lifecycle.compose.LocalLifecycleOwner` (S07, S09), and the newer Material3 pickers (S40).
- Lifecycle artifacts are on different versions (`lifecycle-runtime-ktx` 2.6.2, `lifecycle-viewmodel-compose` 2.8.2).
- Library versions are pinned inline in `app/build.gradle`. The version catalog only holds plugins and unused aliases, and a stale comment at the top of `app/build.gradle` says so.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `gradle/libs.versions.toml`
- `build.gradle.kts` (root: plugin aliases)
- `app/build.gradle`
- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/MainScreen.kt` (only what the upgrade breaks, plus the back arrow icon)
- `DEVELOPERS.md` ("Requirements"; a one-line note on how versions are managed)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - None. The existing unit tests, lint and a device smoke test are the check.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Record the baseline first: `./gradlew :app:dependencies --configuration releaseRuntimeClasspath > <scratchpad>/before.txt` (not in the repo), and the debug APK size.
2. Look up the current stable versions on the official release pages (kotlinlang.org releases, developer.android.com Compose BOM mapping page, androidx lifecycle and room release notes). Pick:
   - the newest stable Kotlin 2.x that the Android Gradle Plugin in the catalog (`agp = "8.13.2"`) supports;
   - the newest stable Compose BOM;
   - the newest stable lifecycle and activity-compose that work with that BOM;
   - Room: keep the current version unless the Kotlin upgrade forces a newer one.
   Record each chosen version and its source URL with `slicer note S53` before editing.
3. Catalog: add every library the app uses to `gradle/libs.versions.toml` (`[versions]` and `[libraries]`), and reference them from `app/build.gradle` as `libs.…`. Use `platform(libs.androidx.compose.bom)` for `implementation`, `androidTestImplementation` and `debugImplementation`, and drop explicit versions from the Compose artifacts. If the BOM no longer lists `material-icons-extended`, give it an explicit version in the catalog.
4. Compose compiler: add the plugin `org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.compose` (same version as Kotlin) to the catalog, to the root `build.gradle.kts` with `apply false`, and to `app/build.gradle`. Delete the `composeOptions { … }` block.
5. Replace `kotlinOptions { jvmTarget = '17' }` with `kotlin { compilerOptions { jvmTarget = org.jetbrains.kotlin.gradle.dsl.JvmTarget.JVM_17 } }`.
6. Lifecycle: use one version for `lifecycle-runtime-ktx` and `lifecycle-viewmodel-compose`, and add `androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-runtime-compose` at the same version (owner-approved as part of this refresh; it provides `LocalLifecycleOwner` and `collectAsStateWithLifecycle`). Do not migrate call sites to it here.
7. Test libraries: align `kotlinx-coroutines-test` with the coroutines version that now resolves at runtime (read it from the dependencies output). Keep `org.json:json` as it is.
8. kapt: keep kapt for Room. If the Kotlin 2 build fails in kapt, stop and record the error with `slicer note S53`. Moving to KSP adds a plugin and needs the owner's approval.
9. compileSdk: if `checkDebugAarMetadata` fails because a library needs a higher compile SDK, raise `compileSdk` only (install that SDK platform). Leave `targetSdk` at 34 (S48 raises it). Update the "Android SDK" lines in `DEVELOPERS.md` and `BUILDING.md` to the new compile SDK.
10. Delete the "NOTE: Dependency versions…" comment at the top of `app/build.gradle`, and the unused catalog aliases (`androidx-core-ktx` stays if used, `junit`/`espresso` aliases stay only if referenced).
11. Fix compile errors with the smallest change. Replace `Icons.Default.ArrowBack` with `Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.ArrowBack` (RTL mirroring). Leave other deprecation warnings alone, and list them with `slicer note S53`.
12. Run the baseline command again and record the before and after dependency count and APK size with `slicer note S53`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug assembleRelease` passes from a clean checkout with only `JAVA_HOME` (JDK 17) set.
- `rg -n "composeOptions|kotlinCompilerExtensionVersion|kotlinOptions" app/build.gradle` returns nothing, and `rg -n "'[a-z.]+:[a-z-]+:[0-9]" app/build.gradle` returns nothing (every version comes from the catalog).
- Smoke test on a device or emulator: create a tracker, log an entry, open the detail, open Settings, export a backup. No crash in `adb logcat`.
- CI (`build.yml`) is green after the owner pushes.
